general.notes: Power consumption stated as < 8W (worst case). Transmitter/receiver power specs are average power, per lane (footnote 3). Receiver min input and overload specified at BER 1x10-12 (footnote 4). Power budget 0 – 7.3dB w/o optical path penalties. Aggregated line rate 2x 103.12Gbps for 200GbE; line rate per lane 25.78Gbps (footnotes 1–2). Dual CS: two SM fiber pairs, 2x100G breakout. Ordering variants SO-QSFP-DD-2C-10 (CMIS3) and SO-QSFP-DD-2C-10-4 (CMIS4). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C is not normal operating range.
